payout_quote: Suburban Cook County: election judges receive $250 total, covering training class, polling-place setup, and Election Day; Election Day runs approximately 5:00 a.m. to 8:00/8:30 p.m.
steps: Apply as an election judge with the Cook County Clerk
Attend the training class and help with polling-place setup
catches: ~15.5-hour Election Day; the $250 covers training and setup too, not just Election Day.
Suburban Cook County only — Chicago city elections are run separately.
Per-election work, a few times per year.
biggest_catch: $250 flat for training + setup + a ~15.5-hour Election Day — about $16/hour all-in.
eligibility: Registered voters in suburban Cook County, 18+.
timing: Paid after the election for the full assignment.
